name: UwU Lend sUSDe price provider spot-median manipulation
summary: sUSDePriceProviderBUniCatch.getPrice() takes the median of eleven USDe price observations, but five of them are instantaneous Curve spot quotes read through get_p(0) on five hard-coded pools (FRAX, USDC, DAI, crvUSD, GHO), alongside five price_oracle(0) EMAs and one Uniswap V3 TWAP. Because a single transaction can move all five get_p inputs at once, the sorted median is pushed to whichever end of the honest cluster the attacker chooses; the code applies no deviation, staleness or spot-versus-EMA sanity check before scaling the median by sUSDeScalingFactor and returning it as the sUSDe price. All five pool addresses are compile-time constants, so no parameter value makes the deployed logic sound. Flash-loaned swaps across those pools drove UwU's reported sUSDe price from 1.03040982 to 0.98821237 and then to 1.03183659 inside the anchor transaction while the five EMA inputs stayed byte-identical, and the attacker converted that mispricing into deposits, borrows and self-liquidations that emptied every UwU reserve.

loss.notes: Quantities are the exact underlying balances that left UwU's nine funded uToken reserve contracts during the 2024-06-10 campaign, measured both from receipt Transfer logs and by reading each underlying token's balanceOf(uToken) at block 20061318 and block 20061352: every reserve went from its pre-attack balance to zero. The campaign is the anchor transaction plus 0xb3f067618ce54bc26a960b660cfc28f9ea0315e2e9a1a855ede1508eb4017376 (block 20061322, the CRV reserve) and 0xca1bbf3b320662c89232006f1ec6624b56242850f07e0f1dadbe4f69ba0d6ac3 (block 20061352, the WBTC, WETH, sDAI, crvUSD and UWU reserves); all three call the same defective price provider. Eight components are valued at DefiLlama prices timestamped within about four minutes of the anchor. The protocol's own UWU token has no DefiLlama price and is recorded with an exact quantity and a null USD value, so the total is a floor with respect to that component. The CRV component is the largest and is spot-marked: the attacker moved 23,617,586.25 CRV to 0xafca625321df8d6a068bdd8f1585d489d2acf11b and still holds 13,491,866.08 CRV there, so that quantity was never realised in the market; widely reported totals of about USD 19.4 million are consistent with a lower effective CRV valuation. The separate 2024-06-13 attack (transaction 0x9235e0662e230bdfa94f56f4932fd09a95fea17e4b9b44a4f40a59449e216110) drained the reserves that had been refilled after 2024-06-10, never calls this price provider, and is deliberately excluded from this loss.

ageReset.description: sUSDePriceProviderBUniCatch is an immutable non-proxy contract; its runtime is byte-identical at its creation block and immediately before the exploit.

sources.note: Reviewed the anchor receipt (status 1, block 20061319 index 0, timestamp 1718021159, a contract-creation transaction whose constructor runs the attack), the callTracer output, the UwU oracle chain, the verified provider source, the provider deployment, every attacker transaction before and after the attack, and the reserve balances. Anchor completeness: the attacker EOA 0x841ddf093f5188989fa1524e7b893de64b421f47 sent six earlier transactions (blocks 20040618 to 20045395); callTracer shows none of them touches the UwU LendingPool 0x2409af0251dcb89ee3dee572629291f9b087c668, the UwU oracle 0xac4a2ac76d639e10f2c05a41274c1af85b772598, or the price provider, so 0x242a0fb4 is the earliest defect-executing success. Defect location: LendingPool -> LendingPoolAddressesProvider.getPriceOracle() -> AaveOracle 0xac4a2ac76d639e10f2c05a41274c1af85b772598, whose getSourceOfAsset(sUSDe) is the zero address, so pricing falls through to FallbackOracle 0x9bc6333081266e55d88942e277fc809b485698b9 whose assetToPriceGetter mapping slot keccak256(sUSDe . 1) = 0x25afb4c646b8460b38c2593f7c61b0206833169aae197987e2c8ca5855923499 holds 0xd252953818bdf8507643c237877020398fa4b2e8, the Etherscan-verified sUSDePriceProviderBUniCatch. The boundary test is met on the defect-bearing side: FRAX_POOL, USDC_POOL, DAI_POOL, CRVUSD_POOL and GHO_POOL are Solidity constants baked into the runtime, and the only owner-settable state is sUSDeScalingFactor (1047) and owner, so no parameter value repairs the median-of-eleven-with-five-spot-inputs logic. The AaveOracle/FallbackOracle wiring that selects this provider is configuration and is deliberately not aged. Manipulation is reproduced from the trace: the provider is called 40 times in the anchor transaction, returning 0.98821237 for the first 17 calls and 1.03183659 for the last 23, against 1.03040982 read at block 20061318. Across those two reads the five price_oracle(0) EMA inputs are identical (1.0027345472606952, 1.0592609008369624, 0.9993933339201766, 0.9976792067649652, 1.0019903273408974) while the five get_p(0) spot inputs swing from (0.939753172036428, 1.0779677677119983, 1.0415553740815684, 1.0543627510365698, 0.8810271550570183) to (1.0695441406109256, 0.9205307406221794, 0.9579737765914418, 0.9449281539973308, 1.1592287075587389), which is exactly the five-of-eleven control the source predicts. Code history: the provider is a plain non-proxy contract created by top-level CREATE from 0x00004c2e74a38bccf68993514cc06375ca554321 in transaction 0x7020c69b8f6547b5db906a9c34bfda076e1230853a66911bd2556c3154ee95ad at block 19662429 index 101; its runtime hashes to 0xab609be9fd7dd78230faa321c93dce5b9989438928aae767a607001b7248e036 at both block 19662429 and block 20061318, giving 4,818,684 seconds (55.8 days) of age. Loss: nine UwU uToken reserves were emptied to exactly zero across three transactions in blocks 20061319, 20061322 and 20061352; underlying balanceOf(uToken) readings at block 20061318 and block 20061352 reproduce every quantity recorded here. The 2024-06-13 follow-up transaction 0x9235e0662e230bdfa94f56f4932fd09a95fea17e4b9b44a4f40a59449e216110 makes zero calls to this provider and is excluded from both the campaign and the loss.

limitations: The CRV component is marked at the DefiLlama incident-time price although the attacker never liquidated 13,491,866.08 of the 25,326,128.47 CRV taken; commonly reported totals of about USD 19.4 million imply a lower effective CRV valuation.
The 498,960.11 UWU taken has no price source and contributes zero to the USD total, so the total understates gross depletion by that component.

notes: The Aave-v2-fork LendingPool that consumed the price is not aged as a target: its code applies the configured oracle as designed, and which oracle it consults is a configuration parameter rather than an executable-code defect.
The 2024-06-13 attack on the same protocol is a separate campaign against a different price source and is not represented by this record.
